name: Rogue
notes: Shared 1st class: §6.1 (Sagittarius path, bow) and §7.1 (Adventurer path, dagger). Rows of both tables are merged per skill; the weapon check (R1) picks the path.

§6.1 "Never auto: Mortal Blow (16), Bleed (96): dagger only → skip with a bow" and §7.1 "Never auto: Rapid Shot (99), Stun Shot (101) with a dagger" are weapon skips (R1), written into those rows, not blocks: the other path uses them.
§7.1 "Toggles / buffs / emergency: Vicious Stance, Accuracy, Dash 🎯, Ultimate Evasion 🎯 HP < 40 %: as §6.1" = the same rows below.
Party role (Sagittarius path): ranged DD. Stands 600-900 behind the tank and shoots the tank's target. Never pulls in a party.
Party role (Adventurer path): melee DD behind the tank's target. Blow skills land more often from the side/back (Scripts/data/positional_skills.json, POSBEHIND).

rows.trig: Opener from range, then on cooldown (6 s, 67 MP: heavy MP for level 5-19, keep it as the opener only).
rows.why: Guide aspect: single target; its rule makes it the opener only (MP cost).

rows.trig: Sagittarius path: main skill (to L24), 6 s, 67 MP. Spam while MP > 30 %, otherwise auto-shots. Adventurer path: only if a bow is equipped (some players level the Rogue with a bow); otherwise skip.
(36) Damage + stun 9 s (40 % chance), 3 s. 🎯 A monster on me / on the healer, or a runner. Adventurer path: never with a dagger.
rows.why: "on the healer / a runner" stays in the trigger text.

rows.trig: Adventurer path (to L24): spam (3 s, 30 MP), from the side/back. Sagittarius path: dagger only → skip with a bow.
Adventurer path (24+): bleed DoT 20 s + slow. 🎯 Long-lived targets (elites, raid minions); not on trash that dies in 3 hits. Sagittarius path: dagger only → skip with a bow.
(32) Bow atk speed +, 20 min: keep it up. Adventurer path: never with a dagger.
+speed 15 s: 🎯 to escape / reposition, never as a routine buff.
(28) Evasion + 30 s, 15 min reuse. HP < 40 % with a monster on me.
Chests/doors only (the bot ignores Treasure Chests).
